pillars.title: Decide early
pillars.body: Orientation, massing and light are settled before anything is styled. They are the decisions that cannot be bought back later.

pillars.title: Short material palettes
pillars.body: Few materials, used honestly and detailed properly, age better than many materials used briefly.

pillars.title: Draw what gets built
pillars.body: We supervise our own drawings on site, so the detail that was designed is the detail that gets executed.

process.title: Enquiry
process.body: Site visit, brief, budget and programme - established honestly up front.

process.title: Concept
process.body: Site study, massing and a plan that answers the brief rather than decorating it.

process.title: Design development
process.body: Materials, services, joinery and lighting resolved together, not in sequence.

process.title: Approvals
process.body: Statutory drawings, sanctions and coordination with structural and MEP consultants.

process.title: Construction
process.body: Tender, contractor selection and a working drawing set built to be built from.

process.title: Handover
process.body: Site supervision through completion, snagging and final handover.
